h1: Cambodia tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Cambodia? This page explains the Cambodia tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay
documents: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 6 months
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Cambodia tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Cambodia. You can apply online for a tourist eVisa before travelling, or get a visa on arrival at main airports.

sections.heading: What a Cambodia tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Cambodia tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Cambodia. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Cambodia business visa](/cambodia-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually have the same options, depending on their nationality. Check whether you also need to complete an online arrival form before you fly, as Cambodia has introduced one for travellers.

sections.heading: Cambodia tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Cambodia tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Cambodia.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Cambodia tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Cambodia tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Cambodia on a Cambodia tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Cambodia tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
